name: n8n
description: n8n is a workflow automation platform aimed at technical users, combining a visual drag-and-drop canvas with the option to drop into custom code, used for both app-to-app automation and building AI agents.
platforms: Self-hosted via Docker, npm, or Kubernetes
best_for: Positioned for technical teams — IT Ops, Security Operations, DevOps, and Sales — who want to automate processes while retaining full visibility and control, including via self-hosting.
features: Visual workflow builder with inline custom code
Hundreds of pre-built app integrations plus custom API connections
AI agent building with multi-agent setups and RAG support
Enterprise controls: SSO/SAML, audit logs, RBAC, Git-based deployment

alternatives.name: Zapier
alternatives.description: A no-code automation platform connecting thousands of apps through simple trigger-and-action workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Non-technical teams wanting the simplest setup

alternatives.name: Make
alternatives.description: A visual automation platform where users build multi-step workflows connecting apps and AI models on a drag-and-drop canvas.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a visual, flowchart-style builder without self-hosting
